system.description:
Lore: Relic Hook

Dockside anglers in Termalaine swear by the hook, even the ones who've been walloped by an indignant flying fish for their trouble.

A tiny silver fishhook with a gold feather tied to it. Tie it to a line and immerse it in at least a 10-foot cube of water. At the end of each uninterrupted Hour of immersion, roll a d6 - on a 6, a floppy 6-inch magical fish appears on the hook. Roll or choose on the table below. Once it conjures a fish, it can't do so again until the next dawn.

d8FishEffect
1-4Green, copper bandsA day's nourishment for one creature if eaten within 24 Hours, then it rots.
5-6Yellow, black stripesThrown up to Far at a Being it can see: pass [Reflex] or be knocked Prone. The fish then vanishes.
7Blue, white bandsSprouts wings and sings sweetly, following you around for 2d4 Hours or until it drops to 0 HP (HD: 1, 4 HP, Fly 30').
8Gold, silver stripesA day's nourishment and 2d10 temporary HP if eaten within 24 Hours, then it rots.

It has the following Powers:

  • Fisher's Luck: At the end of each uninterrupted Hour immersed in at least a 10-foot cube of water, roll d6. On a 6 it lands a fish large enough to feed 1d4 Beings; on a 1 it lands something that objects.

Value: 500g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
